chunk_text: PATERNAL HAPPINESS. If the lOth lord is strong and be in exaltation or in own house/navamsa, the native will derive extreme paternal happiness, will enjoy, fame and will perform good deeds.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 19 - EFFECTS OF THE 1Oth HOUSE

chunk_text: If the l0th lord is devoid of strength, the native will face obstructions in his work.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 19 - EFFECTS OF THE 1Oth HOUSE

chunk_text: If Rahu is in an angle or in a trine, he will perform religious sacrifices like Jyotishtoma.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 19 - EFFECTS OF THE 1Oth HOUSE

chunk_text: If the l0th lord is with a benefic or be in an auspicious house, one will always gain through royal patronage and in business. In a contrary situation, only opposite results will come to pass.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 19 - EFFECTS OF THE 1Oth HOUSE

chunk_text: Should the l0th and the 1st be both occupied by malefics the native will indulge only in bad deeds and will defile his own men.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 19 - EFFECTS OF THE 1Oth HOUSE

chunk_text: If the lord of the l0th is relegated to the 8th along with Rahu, the native will hate others, be a great fool and will do bad deeds.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 19 - EFFECTS OF THE 1Oth HOUSE

chunk_text: If Saturn, Mars and the l0th lord are in the 7th as the 7th lord is with a malefic, the native will be fond of carnal pleasures and of filling his belly.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 19 - EFFECTS OF THE 1Oth HOUSE

chunk_text: Should the l0th lord be in exaltation and be in the company of Jupiter as the 9th lord is in the l0th the native will be endowed with honour, wealth, and valour.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 19 - EFFECTS OF THE 1Oth HOUSE

chunk_text: One will lead a happy life if the 11th lord is in the 10th and the 10th lord is in the ascendant or if the lords of the 10th and 11th are conjunct in an angle.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 19 - EFFECTS OF THE 1Oth HOUSE

chunk_text: Should the l0th lord in strength be in Pisces along with Jupiter, the native will doubtless obtain robes, ornaments and happiness.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 19 - EFFECTS OF THE 1Oth HOUSE

chunk_text: Should Rahu, Sun, Saturn and Mars be in the 11th, the native will incur cessation of his duties.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 19 - EFFECTS OF THE 1Oth HOUSE

chunk_text: One will be learned and wealthy if Jupiter is in Pisces along with Venus while the ascendant lord is strong and the Moon is in exaltation.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 19 - EFFECTS OF THE 1Oth HOUSE
meta_groups: ['Dharma & Spiritual Path', 'Financial Dynamics', 'Knowledge & Wisdom', 'Strength & Success Yogas']

chunk_text: Should the l0th lord be in the 11th while the 11th lord is in the ascendant and Venus is in the l0th, the native will be endowed with precious stones.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 19 - EFFECTS OF THE 1Oth HOUSE

chunk_text: If the lord of the l0th is exalted in an angle or a trine and be in the company of or in aspect to Jupiter, one will be endowed with (worthy) deeds.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 19 - EFFECTS OF THE 1Oth HOUSE

chunk_text: Should the l0th lord be in the ascendant along with the ascendant lord as the Moon is in an angle or in a trine, the native will be interested in good deeds.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 19 - EFFECTS OF THE 1Oth HOUSE

chunk_text: If Saturn is in the 10th along with a debilitated planet while the l0th from Navamsa ascendant is occupied by a malefic, the native will be bereft of (virtuous) acts.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 19 - EFFECTS OF THE 1Oth HOUSE

chunk_text: One will indulge in bad acts if the l0th lord is in the 8th while the 8th lord is in the l0th with a malefic.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 19 - EFFECTS OF THE 1Oth HOUSE

chunk_text: Obstructions to the native's acts will crop up if the l0th lord is in fall, as both the l0th house from the ascendant and the l0th from the 10th (i.e., 7th from the ascendant) have malefic occupations.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 19 - EFFECTS OF THE 1Oth HOUSE
